jobs.description:
Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 900 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units and include the Communications, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Risk, Strategy & Projects, and Tax departments.

The Pictet Investment Research Institute is an advanced investment research capability within Pictet Group, established in 2024.

The Institute’s goal is to conduct in-depth research on topics with long-term implications for Pictet’s business on topics ranging from geopolitics to macroeconomics to portfolio implementation issues.

We are looking for a recent PhD graduate to join the internal team of researchers and contribute to the research output of the Institute. The term of the contract is two years. At the end of the two-year period, the researcher will have the opportunity to be considered for permanent research positions within the Institute.

Your role

• Contribute to research projects of importance to the Pictet Institute.
• Work closely with the Head of the Pictet Institute to formulate the research methodology of the projects and perform the empirical analysis.
• Work closely with the other members of the Institute’s research team on advancing the individual projects, from the research stage to the completion and distribution of the published papers.
• Interact with academics affiliated with the Institute on matters related to the Institute’s research agenda.
• Contribute to writing the research papers on an as-needed basis.

Your profile

• PhD in Finance or a related field from an accredited institution. Individuals without a PhD will not be considered.
• Strong coding skills in Matlab, Python and SQL.
• At ease working with other researchers or investment professionals as well as alone, as necessary.
• Good communication skills, both oral and written, as well as ability to convey complex subject matters to a non-technical audience in a precise and concise manner.
• Excellent command of English.
• Must be willing and able to work in Geneva, Switzerland.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref.: JR/MH/MV

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra

Le funzioni aziendali comprendono le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e impiega oltre 900 persone. Queste funzioni sono svolte da specialisti con competenze in tutte le unità aziendali e includono le Comunicazioni, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legale, Risk, Strategy & Projects e dipartimenti fiscali.

Il Pictet Investment Research Institute è una capacità di ricerca di investimento avanzata all'interno del Pictet Group, fondata nel 2024.

L’obiettivo dell’Istituto è quello di condurre una ricerca approfondita su argomenti con implicazioni a lungo termine per il business di Pictet su argomenti che vanno dalla geopolitica alla macroeconomia ai problemi di implementazione del portafoglio.

Siamo alla ricerca di un recente dottorato di ricerca per aderire al team interno di ricercatori e contribuire alla produzione di ricerca dell'Istituto. Il termine del contratto è di due anni. Alla fine del biennio, il ricercatore avrà la possibilità di essere considerato per posizioni di ricerca permanenti all'interno dell'Istituto.

Il tuo ruolo

• Contribuire a progetti di ricerca di importanza per l'Istituto Pictet.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Capo dell'Istituto Pictet per formulare la metodologia di ricerca dei progetti ed eseguire l'analisi empirica.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli altri membri del team di ricerca dell’Istituto per promuovere i singoli progetti, dalla fase di ricerca al completamento e distribuzione dei documenti pubblicati.
• Interagire con gli accademici affiliati con l'Istituto su questioni relative all'agenda di ricerca dell'Istituto.
• Contribuire a scrivere i documenti di ricerca su base non necessaria.

Il tuo profilo

• PhD in Finanza o un campo correlato da un istituto accreditato. Gli individui senza un dottorato non saranno considerati.
• Forte capacità di codifica in Matlab, Python e SQL.
• A proprio agio lavorare con altri ricercatori o professionisti di investimento, così come da soli, se necessario.
• Buone capacità di comunicazione, sia orale che scritta, nonché capacità di trasmettere argomenti complessi a un pubblico non tecnico in modo preciso e conciso.
• Ottimo comando dell'inglese.
• Deve essere disposto e in grado di lavorare a Ginevra, in Svizzera.

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie.

Rif.: JR/MH/MV

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione nel posto di lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Dein Team

Corporate Functions umfasst die Nichtbankaktivitäten der Gruppe und beschäftigt mehr als 900 Mitarbeiter. Diese Funktionen werden von Spezialisten mit Fachwissen in allen Geschäftsbereichen wahrgenommen und umfassen die Abteilungen Kommunikation, Compliance, Corporate Office, Finanzen, Personal, Informationssicherheit, interne Revision, Recht, Risiko, Strategie & Projekte und Steuer.

Das Pictet Investment Research Institute ist eine fortschrittliche Anlageforschungseinrichtung innerhalb der Pictet Group, die 2024 gegründet wurde.

Ziel des Instituts ist es, eingehende Forschung zu Themen mit langfristigen Auswirkungen auf das Geschäft von Pictet zu Themen durchzuführen, die von Geopolitik über Makroökonomie bis hin zu Fragen der Portfolioimplementierung reichen.

Wir suchen einen kürzlichen Doktoranden, der sich dem internen Forscherteam anschließt und zur Forschungsleistung des Instituts beiträgt. Die Laufzeit des Vertrags beträgt zwei Jahre. Am Ende der zweijährigen Laufzeit hat der Forscher die Möglichkeit, für unbefristete Forschungsstellen innerhalb des Instituts in Betracht gezogen zu werden.

Deine Rolle

• Beitrag zu Forschungsprojekten, die für das Pictet-Institut von Bedeutung sind.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Leiter des Pictet-Instituts zusammen, um die Forschungsmethodik der Projekte zu formulieren und die empirische Analyse durchzuführen.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit den anderen Mitgliedern des Forschungsteams des Instituts zusammen, um die einzelnen Projekte von der Forschungsphase bis zur Fertigstellung und Verteilung der veröffentlichten Arbeiten voranzutreiben.
• Interagieren Sie mit dem Institut angeschlossenen Akademikern in Fragen der Forschungsagenda des Instituts.
• Tragen Sie dazu bei, die Forschungsarbeiten nach Bedarf zu schreiben.

Dein Profil

• PhD in Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich von einer akkreditierten Institution. Personen ohne PhD werden nicht berücksichtigt.
• Starke Programmierkenntnisse in Matlab, Python und SQL.
• Mit Leichtigkeit arbeiten mit anderen Forschern oder Anlageexperten sowie allein, wie nötig.
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich, sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen einem nicht-technischen Publikum auf präzise und prägnante Weise zu vermitteln.
• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.
• Muss bereit und in der Lage sein, in Genf, Schweiz, zu arbeiten.

Anmerkung:

Wir werden keine CVs über Agenturen akzeptieren.

Ref.: JR/MH/MV

Pictet ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und engagiert sich für die Schaffung eines vielfältigen Umfelds. Wir respektieren alle Menschen und suchen ihre Einbeziehung in den Arbeitsplatz.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre équipe

Les fonctions d'entreprise comprennent les activités non bancaires du Groupe et emploient plus de 900 personnes. Ces fonctions sont exercées par des spécialistes spécialisés dans toutes les unités opérationnelles et comprennent les services des communications, de la conformité, des finances, des ressources humaines, de la sécurité de l'information, de la vérification interne, du droit, du risque, de la stratégie et des projets, et des services fiscaux.

L'Institut de recherche en investissement Pictet est une capacité de recherche en investissement avancée au sein du groupe Pictet, établie en 2024.

L'Institut a pour objectif de mener des recherches approfondies sur des sujets ayant des implications à long terme pour les entreprises de Pictet sur des sujets allant de la géopolitique à la macroéconomie à la mise en oeuvre de portefeuilles.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un récent doctorat pour rejoindre l'équipe interne de chercheurs et contribuer aux résultats de recherche de l'Institut. La durée du contrat est de deux ans. À la fin de la période de deux ans, le chercheur aura la possibilité d'être considéré pour des postes de recherche permanents au sein de l'Institut.

Votre rôle

• Contribuer à des projets de recherche importants pour l'Institut Pictet.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le chef de l'Institut Pictet pour formuler la méthodologie de recherche des projets et effectuer l'analyse empirique.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les autres membres de l'équipe de recherche de l'Institut pour faire progresser les projets individuels, depuis la phase de recherche jusqu'à l'achèvement et la distribution des documents publiés.
• Interagir avec les universitaires affiliés à l'Institut sur des questions liées au programme de recherche de l'Institut.
• Contribuer à rédiger les documents de recherche selon les besoins.

Votre profil

• Doctorat en finance ou domaine connexe d'un établissement agréé. Les personnes sans doctorat ne seront pas prises en considération.
• Fortes compétences de codage dans Matlab, Python et SQL.
• À l'aise de travailler avec d'autres chercheurs ou professionnels de l'investissement aussi bien que seul, au besoin.
• De bonnes compétences en communication, tant orale qu'écrite, ainsi que la capacité de transmettre des sujets complexes à un auditoire non technique de manière précise et concise.
• Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais.
• Doit être disposé et capable de travailler à Genève, Suisse.

Remarque

Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire d'agences.

Réf.: JR/MH/MV

Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons toutes les personnes et cherchons à les inclure dans le milieu de travail.

jobs.description:
Your team

Les opérations assurent un traitement sécurisé et efficace des transactions bancaires et des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Nos équipes veillent à ce que toutes les activités respectent les réglementations et gèrent les risques. En développant et en maintenant une infrastructure moderne et robuste, nous garantissons des services fiables et de haute qualité pour la gestion de patrimoine, la gestion d'actifs et de l’immobilier.

Le service Transaction Processing gère l’exécution, le suivi des opérations financières du Groupe. Il intervient sur les transferts de titres, mouvements de cash, paiements, opérations sur instruments financiers.

L’équipe Production Support est le point d’entrée et l’interlocuteur privilégié pour les Business Lines clientes, les équipes opérationnelles, chefs de projets et équipes IT. Elle joue un rôle central dans la coordination, le testing business, le change management et la documentation des flux et processus.
La capacité à promouvoir l'amélioration continue des processus et la qualité du service à la clientèle sont les valeurs promues par l’équipe.
Production Support agit comme un véritable hub de communication et de collaboration, favorisant le partage d’information, l’entraide et la montée en compétence collective.

Your role

• Coordonner des projets transverses impliquant plusieurs équipes (opérationnelles, IT, métiers), organiser et animer des séances de suivi, assurer la transmission et la clarté de l’information.
• Identifier, en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles, les axes d’amélioration des process et initier des projets pour optimiser l’efficacité et réduire les risques opérationnels des équipes de Transaction Processing.
• Participer activement à l’analyse, au testing business et au change management lors de la mise en place de nouveaux process.
• Dans le cadre de projet, s’assurer que les flux business et les processus sont documentés, que les procédures sont mises à jour ainsi que les supports de formation.
• Réaliser des contrôles récurrents de 2ème niveau
• Assurer l’onboarding des nouveaux clients de nos Business Lines PAM et PAS au niveau banque dépositaire
• Encourager la coopération et le partage d’expertise en sollicitant les interlocuteurs clés pour faire émerger des solutions concrètes et efficientes.

Your profile

• Bachelor en finance, systèmes d’information ou titre jugé équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée (5 ans minimum) dans le domaine bancaire, idéalement en coordination ou gestion de projets.
• Excellente connaissance des activités et flux opérationnels de banque dépositaire.
• Compétences en gestion de projet, business analyse, testing et change management.
• Maîtrise d’Avaloq et des outils financiers (un atout).
• Parfaite maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (écrit et oral).
• Maîtrise des outils informatiques MS Office ; Aisance avec les outils IA ; connaissance de Jira, Sharepoint, Wiki, Phyton, WBA Excel.
• Esprit d'équipe, communication, goût pour la documentation et capacité à mobiliser les bonnes personnes.
• Domiciles en Suisse requis.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

La tua squadra

Le operazioni garantiscono un trattamento sicuro ed efficiente dei fondi bancari e di investimento di Pictet. I nostri team garantiscono che tutte le attività siano conformi alle normative e gestiscano i rischi. Sviluppando e mantenendo un'infrastruttura moderna e robusta, garantiamo servizi affidabili e di alta qualità per la gestione degli asset, la gestione degli asset e il settore immobiliare.

Il dipartimento Transaction Processing gestisce l'implementazione e il monitoraggio delle operazioni finanziarie del Gruppo. Interviene sui trasferimenti di titoli, movimenti di cassa, pagamenti, operazioni su strumenti finanziari.

Il team di supporto alla produzione è il punto di ingresso e il punto di contatto preferito per clienti di Business Lines, team operativi, project manager e team IT. Ha un ruolo centrale nel coordinare, testare le imprese, cambiare la gestione e documentare i flussi e i processi.
La capacità di promuovere il miglioramento continuo del processo e la qualità del servizio clienti sono i valori promossi dal team.
Il supporto alla produzione funge da vero hub per la comunicazione e la collaborazione, promuovendo la condivisione delle informazioni, il sostegno reciproco e l'ascesa di competenze collettive.

Il tuo ruolo

• Coordinate i progetti di cross-cutting che coinvolgono diverse squadre (operative, IT, trade), organizzano e conducono sessioni di follow-up, assicurano la trasmissione e la chiarezza delle informazioni.
• Identificare, in collaborazione con i team operativi, le aree per il miglioramento dei processi e avviare progetti per ottimizzare l'efficienza e ridurre i rischi operativi dei team di Transaction Processing.
• Partecipa attivamente alla gestione delle analisi, dei test e dei cambiamenti aziendali durante l'implementazione di nuovi processi.
• Nell'ambito del progetto, assicurarsi che i flussi e i processi aziendali siano documentati, le procedure vengono aggiornate e i materiali di formazione.
• Effettuare controlli ricorrenti di secondo livello
• Imbarcando nuovi clienti delle nostre linee commerciali PAM e PAS a livello di banca depositaria
• Incoraggiare la cooperazione e la condivisione delle competenze sollecitando interlocutori chiave per soluzioni concrete ed efficienti.

Il tuo profilo

• Corso di laurea in finanza, sistemi informativi o titolo ritenuto equivalente.
• Esperienza confermata (5 anni minimo) nel settore bancario, idealmente in coordinamento o project management.
• Ottima conoscenza delle operazioni bancarie depositarie e dei flussi operativi.
• Competenze nella gestione dei progetti, nell'analisi aziendale, nella gestione dei test e dei cambiamenti.
• Mastery di Avaloq e strumenti finanziari (un bene).
• Perfetta padronanza di francese e inglese (scritto e orale).
• Mastery of MS Office computer tools; Aisance with AI tools; conoscenza di Jira, Sharepoint, Wiki, Phyton, WBA Excel.
• Spirito di squadra, comunicazione, gusto per la documentazione e la capacità di mobilitare le persone giuste.

Your team

Operations ensure secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking and investment funds. Our teams ensure that all activities comply with regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern and robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable and high-quality services for asset management, asset management and real estate.

The Transaction Processing department manages the implementation and monitoring of the Group's financial operations. It intervenes on transfers of securities, cash movements, payments, transactions on financial instruments.

The Production Support team is the preferred entry point and contact point for Business Lines clients, operational teams, project managers and IT teams. It plays a central role in coordinating, testing business, changing management and documenting flows and processes.
The ability to promote continuous process improvement and the quality of customer service are the values promoted by the team.
Production Support acts as a real hub for communication and collaboration, promoting information sharing, mutual support and the rise of collective competence.

Your role

• Coordinate cross-cutting projects involving several teams (operational, IT, trades), organize and conduct follow-up sessions, ensure the transmission and clarity of information.
• Identify, in conjunction with operational teams, the areas for process improvement and initiate projects to optimize efficiency and reduce the operational risks of Transaction Processing teams.
• Actively participate in business analysis, testing and change management when implementing new processes.
• As part of the project, ensure that business flows and processes are documented, procedures are updated, and training materials.
• Performing 2nd level recurrent checks
• Onboarding new clients of our PAM and PAS Business Lines at the depository bank level
• Encourage cooperation and sharing of expertise by soliciting key interlocutors for concrete and efficient solutions.

Your profile

• Bachelor in finance, information systems or title deemed equivalent.
• Confirmed experience (5 years minimum) in banking, ideally in coordination or project management.
• Excellent knowledge of depositary bank operations and operational flows.
• Skills in project management, business analysis, testing and change management.
• Mastery of Avaloq and financial tools (an asset).
• Perfect mastery of French and English (written and oral).
• Mastery of MS Office computer tools; Aisance with AI tools; knowledge of Jira, Sharepoint, Wiki, Phyton, WBA Excel.

• Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der Einlagenbank Operationen und operativen Stromflüsse.
• Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement, Business-Analyse, Testing und Change Management.
• Beherrschung von Avaloq und Finanzwerkzeugen (ein Asset).

jobs.title: Legal Advisor
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment group and a wholly owned subsidiary of Pictet with expertise in hedge funds, private equity, real estate, private debt and infrastructure. With teams based globally, PAA constructs, manages and advises portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.
You will be part of a team of 20 professionals dedicated to Pictet’s pan-European Direct Real Estate franchise, which began in 2019 with the launch of Elevation Fund I, a EUR 700 million value-add fund. Elevation Fund II was launched in 2023, and a Core Plus fund, with approximately EUR 200 million under management, was launched in 2021. The team is distributed across several locations: in London, where the core investment and asset management teams are based; in Geneva, where the investment legal and investor relations teams operate; and in Berlin and Stockholm, where our regional heads are located. Additionally, fund support functions such as fund administration, compliance, and legal affairs are situated in Luxembourg and London.

Your role

As part of the Direct Real Estate team based in Geneva you will:

• Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of real estate and financing documents, including shareholders’ agreements, financing agreements, lease agreements, SPAs, construction agreements, etc.

• Support direct real estate transactions from inception to closing, helping to drive execution by coordinating legal workstreams, managing negotiations and liaising with internal stakeholders and external advisers.

• Act as a key legal partner on cross-border matters, working closely with internal teams across jurisdictions on transaction status, documentation, payment mechanics and related execution steps.

• Provide day-to-day legal support on asset management and project matters, combining strong technical legal drafting with a practical, commercially minded and solutions-oriented approach to business issues, focused on finding practical solutions to the team’s challenges rather than acting solely as a gatekeeper.

• Lead and support legal documentation for development, construction and refurbishment matters, including preparing, revising and finalising project and works contracts for counterparties.

Your profile

• Between 5 and 8 years post-qualification in the real estate department of a major and reputable law firm ideally completed by in-house experience, and have experienced leading acquisitions, disposals and financings (beyond due diligence support or minor supporting roles).

• Experience working on transactions in at least 3 different jurisdictions.

• The candidate should have flexibility to travel within Europe for business purposes.

• Fluent in English, any additional European language such as French, Spanish, German or Danish would be an asset.

• You have a particular interest of and existing experience with AI tools for task/workflow automation.

• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

As the selected candidate, you have developed a passion for real estate and are seeking to be involved in exciting real estate projects. You are a strong and dedicated professional who genuinely values team spirit and is comfortable with the level of commitment that an M&A role naturally involves, given the pace and unpredictability of live transactions.
With a flat hierarchy and a collaborative culture, success comes from teamwork, open information sharing, and constructive debate, enabling you to learn quickly, contribute meaningfully, and grow. If you are excited about the role but do not meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to providing a supportive environment where people can grow.

Ref: LA/LT/MMC

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
